terms.definitionEn: An ordered collection that stores values under numbered positions.
terms.definitionAr: مجموعة مرتبة بتخزن قيم في أماكن مرقمة.

terms.definitionEn: The numbered position used to access an item, beginning at zero.
terms.definitionAr: رقم المكان اللي بنستخدمه للوصول لعنصر، وبيبدأ من صفر.

terms.definitionEn: A single value stored inside an ordered collection.
terms.definitionAr: قيمة واحدة متخزنة جوه مجموعة مرتبة.

terms.definitionEn: A collection that contains another collection as one of its values.
terms.definitionAr: مجموعة جواها مجموعة تانية كواحدة من قيمها.

terms.definitionEn: A structure whose values are reached through more than one numbered position.
terms.definitionAr: تركيب بنوصل لقيمه باستخدام أكتر من رقم مكان.

terms.definitionEn: The count of positions in an array, including empty slots.
terms.definitionAr: عدد الأماكن في الـ array، وبيشمل الأماكن الفاضية.

terms.definitionEn: A method that appends one or more values and gives back the updated count.
terms.definitionAr: ميثود بتضيف قيم في الآخر وبترجّع العدد بعد التحديث.

terms.definitionEn: A method that removes and gives back the final value.
A method that removes and gives back the value at the first position.
terms.definitionAr: ميثود بتشيل وترجّع القيمة اللي في أول مكان.

terms.definitionEn: A method that inserts one or more values before the current first value.
terms.definitionAr: ميثود بتضيف قيمة أو أكتر قبل أول قيمة موجودة.

terms.definitionEn: A change made directly to an existing value or structure.
terms.definitionAr: تغيير بيحصل مباشرة في قيمة أو تركيب موجود.

terms.definitionEn: The result a method or function sends back to its caller.
terms.definitionAr: النتيجة اللي ميثود أو function بترجّعها للي ناداها.

questions.question: How do assigning an array to another variable and copying its elements differ?
keyPoints: Mutations through either reference are visible
A shallow copy can be made with slice or spread
Nested objects remain shared in a shallow copy
questions.modelAnswer: Assigning an array to another variable copies its reference, so both variables access the same array. A shallow copy such as [...items] creates a distinct outer array, but nested objects inside it are still shared.

questions.question: Compare the values returned by push(), pop(), shift(), and unshift().
keyPoints: push and unshift return the new length
pop returns the removed final item
shift returns the removed first item
Removal from an empty array returns undefined
questions.modelAnswer: push() and unshift() add items and return the resulting length. pop() and shift() remove and return an item from opposite ends, and either returns undefined when there is nothing to remove.

questions.question: How do you read a value from a two-dimensional array, and what should you check when an access gives undefined?
keyPoints: Use one index per nested level
An incorrect shape or index can produce undefined
questions.modelAnswer: Use the row index first and then an index for the value inside that row, such as grid[row][column]. Check that the selected row exists and that the column is within that row's bounds, since a missing position evaluates to undefined.
